title: Hezo Link check request V1
description: Strict, public request shape for one deliberate manual URL check. URL safety and the 8192 UTF-8 byte maximum require semantic validation after schema validation.

url.description: Exact deliberate submission. Do not normalize or strip query or fragment. In addition to this code-point bound, reject values over 8192 UTF-8 bytes and apply the documented semantic URL policy.

wait_budget_ms.description: Nonnegative signed 32-bit completion-wait hint, not a completion promise.
